name: trend-full-reversion-075-current-config
rationale: Lead #3 of the 2026-10-25 report. On the 2026-10-25 window at 500k the trend-weight curve turned: equal weights (with 15m spacing) -3.78%, trend 1.0 / reversion 0.5 -5.64%, trend 1.0 / reversion 0.25 -9.55%. The optimum appears to sit near equal weights; trend 1.0 / reversion 0.75 is the untested point between equal weights and the 0.5 point, on the current baseline config with no other change (rebalance_interval_secs stays 60).
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT to 1.0 and REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT to 0.75. Nothing else changes: every sub-signal formula (RSI, damped SMA cross, damped EMA cross, damped MACD histogram / step fallback, Bollinger %B), the weighted-mean aggregation, the empty-sub_signals warmup guard, the non-positive SMA/EMA guards and the sentiment combination stay byte-for-byte identical. Update both constants' doc comments (and the compute_btc_target doc comment listing the weights) to record that this is a near-equal-weight probe between equal weights and trend 1.0 / reversion 0.5 (2026-10-25 lead #3). Then update the expected values in the compute_btc_target_* unit tests wherever the new weights legitimately change them; any test asserting reversion dominance (e.g. compute_btc_target_mean_reverting_family_dominates_trend_disagreement) must be rewritten to assert the new arithmetic rather than deleted.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.
MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly two numeric constants change (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0, REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.75).

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
